# DG1 round-trip fixtures (draw.io desktop, draw.io web, VS Code extension)

Produced on 2026-10-31 by **scripted edits in a headless macOS VM** (Tart, image `vmgui-base-tahoe-4aaa751f`, macOS 26.6.2),
not by hand: pointer and key events through the VM's own VNC server (vncdotool 1.4.2) plus the Accessibility-based `axdrive`
for typing. Every file here is the app's own save. Nothing was installed on the host; the clone was deleted afterwards.
Status: PARTIAL, see "Gaps". Screenshots per step (taken inside the VM) are in the coordinator's handoff folder
`/Volumes/d7sst7/dev-targets/handoff/dg1-fixtures-evidence/` together with the driver scripts (not in the repo).

## Inputs (`inputs/`, generated by `gen-inputs.mjs`, ADR 0011 canonical form with `<object>` wrappers and `gen_*` records)

1. `01-canonical-basic.drawio`: 4 modules, 3 edges.
2. `02-module-graph.drawio`: 10 modules, 12 edges.
3. `03-c4-containers.drawio`: person, system boundary (container) with three child containers (parent = boundary), external system, labelled edges, HTML labels.
4. `04-labels-styles.drawio`: HTML labels with entities, unicode, a newline, tooltip/link/tags attributes (H16), dashed edge style, a manual cell without `gen_key`.

The `gen_*` hash values are placeholders of the right shape (the real writer arrives with DG1); they only need to survive.

## Edit script (the same for every input; coordinates differ per file in `desk.sh`)

Each step is followed by Save (Cmd+S); the saved file is copied out as `NN-<step>.drawio`. Steps are cumulative.

| File | Step |
|---|---|
| `00-baseline` | open and save with no edit (desktop and web write a file; the VS Code extension does not write an unmodified document) |
| `01-move` | drag one node |
| `02-style` | Edit Style (Cmd+E) on one node: append `fillColor`, `strokeColor`, `dashed=1` |
| `03-add-shape-edge` | select a node, Cmd+Shift+Down (clone and connect: new shape plus new edge) |
| `04-label` | F2 on one node, replace or append label text |
| `05-copy-paste` | copy a generated node and paste elsewhere (id change). Desktop: Cmd+C/V; web and VS Code: Edit menu (Copy, Paste), because keyboard copy did not reach the clipboard there |
| `06-delete` | select a generated node, Delete |
| `07-compressed` | File > Properties > Compressed on, save (desktop and web only) |
| `08-uncompressed-again` | Compressed off, save |

`desktop/cli-export/`: the app's own CLI (`draw.io -x -f xml [-u]`) run on the inputs; `*.cli-xml.drawio` from the plain inputs,
`*.cli-from-compressed*.drawio` from the compressed `07` files.

## Layout

`desktop/<input>/NN-*.drawio` (4 inputs, steps 00 to 08), `web/<input>/NN-*.drawio` (4 inputs, steps 00 to 08),
`vsc/01-canonical-basic/NN-*.drawio` (steps 00 to 06; no 07/08, the extension has no Compressed option).

## Observed behaviours (details in the report that came with this branch)

- Custom attributes (`gen_*`, `tooltip`, `link`, `tags`) and the `<object id="0" gen_page=...>` root wrapper survive every save in all three apps.
- A pasted generated node gets a new random id (`<random>-<n>`) and keeps its `gen_key` and `gen_*` attributes (H2 and H10 shapes).
- A node cloned with Cmd+Shift+Down is a plain new cell with a new id and no `gen_*` unless it was cloned from an `object` (then the wrapper is copied, `gen_key` included).
- Compression: desktop and web write `compressed="false"` by default and `compressed="true"` after the File > Properties toggle; the VS Code extension hard-codes `compressXml:false` (extension source) so it never compresses. A compressed input read by draw.io is written uncompressed again by the VS Code extension (not recorded here, see Gaps).
- `mxfile host` changes per app (`Electron`, `app.diagrams.net`, an opaque id for VS Code); the VS Code extension re-indents the file with 4 spaces; desktop and web keep attribute order roughly but sort wrapper attributes (`id` last) and add `dx`/`dy`.
